notes.title: ver1.11 Knight behavior change, hard mode (test version) added
notes.content:
A test map was added and some changes were made to the knight's behavior before the major update.
A map is scheduled to be added in the next major update.

- Changed the speed of the knight's climbing action.
- You can now change the direction of the knight while crouching.
- Charge jumps can now be pre-input
- You can now play with a knight with new behavior (this will become the default knight in the future).
- Hard mode (test version) has been added.

Currently, there is an issue with the lighting (brightness) of the test map being too dark.

notes.title: Update ver1.10
notes.content:
-Fixed moving books and lasers 
-Added one background music track 
-Changed the distance of hidden jumps 
-Supported some subtitles that were not supported in English 
-Steam achievements can now be unlocked 
-Changed some subtitles

notes.title: Update ver1.9
notes.content:
-Some sounds have been lowered. 
- Adjusted objects that are easily caught by charge jumps. 
- Changed judgment of some objects. 
- Rolling cooldown is now 30 seconds (Rolling is prone to bugs, so we intentionally hide how to operate it). 
- Fixed a problem where the height is moved to the initial position when save & load is performed. If you are at a negative height coordinate when saving and loading, you will be moved to the initial position. 
Fixed a problem where some subtitles are displayed even if they are disabled in the settings. 
Fixed a problem where subtitles are displayed multiple times, so the subtitle status is saved and displayed only once. 
Added one background music track. 

We are currently struggling with the issue of Steam Achievements not being unlocked.

notes.title: Update Minor adjustments to stages and knights
notes.content:
Knights now stop immediately after completing a dash 
Fixed a problem that sometimes prevented charge jumps 
Fixed a problem that prevented mid-air jumps 
Fixed a problem that prevented charge jumps at the fastest speed 
Fixed a problem that caused beds to not speed up properly when cliff-hanging Changed subtitles for shortcut bed release 
Restored a gimmick that was temporarily removed 
Arrows now appear on some beds indicating the direction to fly 
Changed some stages 
Removed some subtitles 
Changed goal times 
Removed some endings Part of the ending has been deleted.

notes.title: Bug Fixes The beds that are trapped are now saved.
notes.content:
Bug fixes 
- Trapped beds are now saved 
- Fixed bug where snow beds would not release 

Current bugs 
- Some subtitles in English would not disappear 
- Achievements would not unlock 
- Sometimes charge jumps would not work 
- No lateral speed when falling, no lateral movement

notes.title: Update: “Camera position changed,” “knight's physical abilities improved overall
notes.content:
The knight has been improved overall.

The camera position has been changed so that the knight is in the middle.
The distance between the knight and the camera has been moved away.
The knight can now point in the correct direction on the ground by holding down the right mouse button.
Moving in the air has been made a little easier. However, it is harder to control in the air for 1 second immediately after a charge jump.
Charge jumps can now be canceled with the space key.
The knight's speed has been increased by 0.3x when he goes from air to ground, and the landing inertial movement after a charge jump has been reduced. (This may be adjusted a little more in the future.) 
・Shortened the time to pause for charge jumps. (It may be adjusted a little more in the future.) 

*Future plans for adjustment 
・If a knight snatches an object while falling, he will be bounced. 
・If a knight stops after running, he will only walk a little. 

Future plans for update 
・The behavior of charge jump and the composition of stages will be changed in the next update.
Support for some English subtitles.
-Implementation of a feature that increases the speed by 0.3x when setting up on the ground, but if you press space just before landing, it will keep the speed. 
-Problem with the progress of the trapped bed not being saved. 

We are checking to see if we can unlock achievements when you reach the goal.

notes.title: Update ver1.3 “Cliff grabbing” enhanced
notes.content:
knight did strength training. Arm strength was improved and the range of grasping was increased.
Three beds have been added for return.
Shortcut jumps at higher difficulty levels have been increased.
The direction of travel has been made a little clearer.
More beds have been added.

notes.title: Update ver.1.2 Adjustment of difficulty level from the beginning to the middle
notes.content:
After its release, “JumpToSpace” for three days was for authors only.
In order to make “JumpToSpace” for purchasers, we drilled and modified it.
*The game may be heavier due to the placement of some new objects.

Adjusted the difficulty level from the beginning to the middle of the game.

Modified 
- Added some beds for the early stages. Please look around and find them. It seems that they are not on the ground.
Added some objects to prevent falling in the early stages.
Added a bed for prisoners. If you see the knight in action, you may be able to escape.
Added some hidden jumps in the beginning.

Other updates 
・Added explanatory subtitles in the beginning.
We prayed to weaken the wind, but it didn't change.
We gave a low kick to the author who is not good at designing difficulty levels.
Temporarily removed BGM of the last stage 
・Temporarily removed some gimmicks 

Bugs not fixed 
・Moving objects go to a position where you can't get on and you can't progress (can be fixed by save & load) 
・Timer does not support notation of 100 hours or more 
・Multiple shadows of knights 

Upcoming updates Plans 
-PAD and controller support 
-Lighter weight 
-Hiding subtitles once seen 
-Support for English subtitles 

Unconfirmed 
-Unknown if Steam achievements can be achieved 
-Bug with too loud initial background music and SE settings 

Currently, the knight has a limited cliff grab range and cries about his arm strength being weak from various people.
He has recently started strength training. The effectiveness will depend on the player's goal percentage.
